symptoms: >5.5 mmol/L (neonates >6.5 mmol/L). Always repeat if high. Stop potassium-containing drugs/solutions.

management_steps.details: 10% Calcium Chloride 10 mL IV slowly (paeds 0.2 mL/kg); or 10% Calcium Gluconate 10 mL IV slowly (paeds 0.5 mL/kg)
Adult Actrapid 10 IU STAT + 20–50 mL 50% D/W; Paediatric Actrapid 0.1 U/kg + 2 mL/kg 25% D/W
Adult 30 g PR 6 hrly; Paediatric 1–2 g/kg PR 6 hrly
